a turn we sent ourselves coming back persisted > gives them their durable row ids, so a second sweep is a no-op
a turn we sent ourselves coming back persisted > leaves every rendered key exactly where it was, twice over
a turn we sent ourselves coming back persisted > still appends a row that is genuinely new
author reconciliation > gives the optimistic bubble the row author once the row lands, without duplicating it
author reconciliation > keeps the row's own author when the pair agrees on the id and differs only in the name
author reconciliation > never pairs the reader’s optimistic bubble with a colleague’s row that says the same thing (tail)
author reconciliation > never pairs the reader’s optimistic bubble with a colleague’s row that says the same thing (hydration)
author reconciliation > still pairs an attributed bubble with an unattributed row: a gateway that stamps nobody
author reconciliation > names a foreign placeholder from the row that fills it
